session_dir.description: The directory where ncdc stores its database, logs, and shared files.

nick.description: Your default nickname displayed in hubs.

description.description: A short public description displayed in hub user lists.

active.description: Enables active mode, allowing others to connect to you for better file sharing.

active_port.description: The TCP/UDP port for incoming connections in active mode.

autoconnect.description: Automatically connect to hubs with autoconnect enabled on startup.

connection.description: Indication of upload speed for other users (e.g., '50' or '2300 KiB/s').

upload_rate.description: Maximum combined transfer rate of all uploads (e.g., '5M'). Overrides connection setting.

download_rate.description: Maximum combined transfer rate of all downloads (e.g., '10M').

download_dir.description: Directory where finished downloads are moved to. Defaults to session_dir/dl/.

incoming_dir.description: Directory where incomplete downloads are stored. Defaults to session_dir/inc/.

minislots.description: Number of minislots for small files or filelist requests when regular slots are full.

max_ul_per_user.description: Maximum number of simultaneous upload connections to one user.

share_hidden.description: Whether to share hidden files and directories (starting with dot).

tls_policy.description: Policy for secure client-to-client connections: disabled, allow, prefer, or force.
